decision_rule: GO is permitted only when every mandatory gate is PASS with current, independently reviewable evidence and accountable approval.

gates.name: Reproducible production build and semantic typecheck
gates.evidence: CI build log, lockfile, typecheck report and artifact digest

gates.name: PostgreSQL clean install and forward migration validation
gates.evidence: Clean bootstrap, migration checksums, schema diff and rollback/forward recovery evidence

gates.name: Authenticated API and browser/mobile E2E
gates.evidence: P584 runtime execution records and retained reports

gates.name: Tenant, outlet, role and IDOR security acceptance
gates.evidence: Positive/negative authorization matrix and independent review

gates.name: Legal, excise, GST and statutory invoice approval
gates.evidence: Jurisdiction-specific official rules, approved tax packs and signed legal/CA acceptance

gates.name: Finance and accounting reconciliation
gates.evidence: Sales-to-GL, inventory valuation, settlement, refund, chargeback and period-close reconciliation

gates.name: Payment provider certification
gates.evidence: Provider sandbox sign-off, webhook replay, refunds, chargebacks and settlement evidence

gates.name: Integration provider and egress certification
gates.evidence: SSRF-safe egress review, signed payloads, retry/DLQ tests and provider sandbox acceptance

gates.name: Backup, restore, disaster recovery and rollback
gates.evidence: Timed restore drill, RPO/RTO evidence, failover and rollback logs

gates.name: Performance, load, concurrency and observability
gates.evidence: Approved workload results, SLO dashboards, alerts and capacity report

gates.name: Device, offline and alcohol posting safety
gates.evidence: Hardware/device acceptance, sync conflict tests and explicit statutory approval for any posting mode

gates.name: Pilot, training, support and operational readiness
gates.evidence: Signed pilot acceptance, training records, support rota, incident playbooks and outlet sign-off

gates.name: Release approvals and rollback rehearsal
gates.evidence: Named accountable approvals, change record, deployment and rollback rehearsal
